rows.result: Server responds quickly: HTTP/2 with 103 Early Hints + preconnects; lab TTFB ~482ms (≤0.8s). Shopify-hosted, CDN-fronted.
Field INP (p75) unavailable — requires CrUX/RUM. Heavy script load (181 script requests) is a risk factor but INP itself is unverified.
rows.next_action: Pull field INP once CrUX/PSI or GSC is connected.

rows.result: Homepage loads 332 resources including 181 script requests and 40 stylesheets — a very heavy, app-laden critical path (Shopify apps + third parties: GoKwik, Snapmint, flash-speed, cdnjs, googleapis). This is the primary performance risk and likely depresses field LCP/INP.
rows.next_action: Audit installed Shopify apps; remove/defer unused ones; async/defer non-critical JS; consolidate CSS; inline critical CSS.

rows.result: Field CLS (p75) unavailable — requires CrUX/RUM. Not measurable from a single lab snapshot reliably.
rows.next_action: Pull field CLS once CrUX/PSI or GSC is connected; verify image/ad slots are dimensioned.

rows.result: Lazy-loading is barely used — only 2 of 113 homepage images use loading=lazy, so below-the-fold imagery is fetched eagerly. Images are Shopify-CDN served (WebP-capable via params) but not deferred.
rows.next_action: Add loading=lazy to below-the-fold images; ensure responsive srcset/sizes; confirm WebP/AVIF delivery via Shopify CDN params.
